words.definition: a structure that shoots water into the air for decoration
words.example: The lobby's fountain is a popular photo spot for visitors.
words.exampleTranslation: 大廳的噴泉是訪客熱門的拍照景點。
words.note: 常見於 drinking fountain（飲水機）這個複合詞

words.definition: the liquid extracted from fruit or vegetables
words.example: Fresh juice is served at the welcome reception.
words.exampleTranslation: 歡迎茶會上供應新鮮果汁。
words.note: 不可數名詞，通常說 a glass of juice，而非 a juice

words.definition: a narrow road, or one of the marked sections of a road
words.example: The left lane is closed for road maintenance.
words.exampleTranslation: 左側車道因道路維修而封閉。
words.note: 常見於 bike lane（自行車道）、fast lane（快車道）這類複合詞

words.definition: the state of being liked or supported by many people
words.example: The product's popularity grew quickly after the ad campaign.
words.exampleTranslation: 這項產品在廣告活動後人氣迅速上升。
words.note: 形容詞形：popular (adj.) 受歡迎的，例如 a popular choice among customers。

words.definition: a large printed picture or notice displayed in public
words.example: A poster announcing the sale was put up in the window.
words.exampleTranslation: 櫥窗貼上了一張宣傳特賣的海報。
words.note: 相關詞：post (v.) 張貼，例如 post a notice on the board，poster 即張貼出來的海報

words.definition: immediately or without delay
words.example: Please arrive promptly at nine for the meeting.
words.exampleTranslation: 請在九點準時抵達開會。
words.note: 形容詞形：prompt (adj.) 迅速的；準時的，例如 a prompt reply。

words.definition: a business that sells goods directly to consumers
words.example: The retailer is expanding into three new markets.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家零售商正在擴展到三個新市場。
words.note: 相關詞：retail (n./adj.) 零售，例如 retail price（零售價）

words.definition: an unoccupied position or room available
words.example: There is a vacancy for a senior accountant in our finance team.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們財務團隊有一個資深會計師的職缺。
words.note: 形容詞形：vacant (adj.) 空著的，例如 a vacant room。

words.definition: a long seat for several people
words.example: Visitors can rest on a bench in the courtyard.
words.exampleTranslation: 訪客可以在中庭的長椅上休息。
words.note: 在法律情境中 the bench 可指「法官席」或司法體系

words.definition: increasing by successive additions over time
words.example: The cumulative effect of small savings adds up over a year.
words.exampleTranslation: 小額節省的累積效果，一年下來會相當可觀。
words.note: 動詞形：accumulate (v.) 累積，例如 accumulate frequent-flyer miles。

words.definition: a list of names, addresses, or files organized for easy reference
words.example: You can find her extension in the staff directory.
words.exampleTranslation: 你可以在員工名錄裡找到她的分機號碼。
words.note: 常見於 phone directory（電話簿）這個複合詞

words.definition: the act of getting rid of something
words.example: The company follows strict rules for waste disposal.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司在廢棄物處置上遵守嚴格規定。
words.note: 常用片語 at your disposal（供你使用），與「棄置」的意思不同

words.definition: a person employed to clean and maintain a house or hotel room
words.example: The housekeeper will service the room after checkout.
words.exampleTranslation: 退房後房務人員會來整理房間。
words.note: 相關詞：housekeeping (n.) 家務管理；飯店的房務部，例如 Housekeeping will clean the room at 2 p.m.

words.definition: a temporary position for gaining work experience
words.example: She completed a six-month internship before being hired full time.
words.exampleTranslation: 她完成了六個月的實習後才被正式錄用。
words.note: 相關詞：intern (n./v.) 實習生；實習，例如 She interned at a law firm last summer。

words.definition: having a lot of knowledge or information about a subject
words.example: The staff are knowledgeable about all the products in the store.
words.exampleTranslation: 店裡的員工對所有產品都很了解。
words.note: 相關詞：knowledge (n.) 知識，例如 The training improved his knowledge of safety procedures。

words.definition: a person or thing that arranges or plans an event
words.example: The event organizer confirmed the venue for next month.
words.exampleTranslation: 活動主辦人確認了下個月的場地。
words.note: 英式英文拼作 organiser（用 s 而非 z）

words.definition: not paid, done, or arrived by the expected time
words.example: Please settle any overdue invoices by the end of the week.
words.exampleTranslation: 請在週末前結清任何逾期的發票款項。
words.note: 相關詞：due (adj.) 到期的，例如 The payment is due on the 10th，overdue 則表示「已超過到期日」

words.definition: a statement about what will happen in the future
words.example: Analysts made a prediction about next quarter's sales growth.
words.exampleTranslation: 分析師對下季的銷售成長做出了預測。
words.note: 動詞形：predict (v.) 預測，例如 Experts predict steady growth next year。

words.definition: a person who pays to regularly receive a service or publication
words.example: The newsletter now has over ten thousand subscribers.
words.exampleTranslation: 這份電子報現在有超過一萬名訂閱者。
words.note: 動詞形：subscribe (v.) 訂閱，常搭配介系詞 to，例如 subscribe to a magazine。

words.definition: a small thin book, often with information or instructions
words.example: A booklet explaining the benefits plan was mailed to all staff.
words.exampleTranslation: 一本說明福利方案的小冊子已寄給全體員工。
words.note: 字尾 -let 表示「小型的」，book + let 構成 booklet（小冊子），同樣用法如 piglet（小豬）
